swaps.stem: Choose the correctly spelled word for a special right that comes with an office:
swaps.explanation: Prerogative starts with pre- (before), then -rog- (ask), then -ative. People often drop the first r (perogative) or hear the second vowel as i.

swaps.stem: Which spelling correctly completes this sentence: The clerk _____ the complaint to the legal unit yesterday.
swaps.explanation: Refer is stressed on the last syllable, so the final r doubles before -ed: referred. The f never doubles.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Select the correctly spelled word for money sent to pay a bill.
swaps.explanation: Remit is stressed on -mit, so the t doubles before -ance: remittance. The m stays single, and the ending is -ance, not -ence.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling is correct in the instruction “Attach your travel _____ to the request”?
swaps.explanation: Itinerary has five syllables, i-tin-er-ar-y. Saying each one keeps the -ar- that people drop (itinery) and the i vowels.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which word is correctly spelled in the phrase “a health _____ for every household”?
swaps.explanation: Pamphlet spells the f sound with ph and ends in -let.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: An agreement reached by the whole group is a _____; choose the correct spelling.
swaps.explanation: Consensus comes from consent, so both s sounds are spelled with s: con-sen-sus. It is not related to census.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Choose the correct spelling in the phrase “a _____ to fast service.”
swaps.explanation: Hindrance drops the e of hinder (hind-rance) and ends in -ance.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling is correct for a written order to appear in court?
swaps.explanation: Subpoena keeps the silent b of sub- and the Latin -poena (o before e).
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling completes the instruction “Late applicants _____ their slot”?
swaps.explanation: Forfeit is one of the exceptions to the i-before-e rule, spelled -feit. The prefix is for-, not fore-.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling is correct in the sentence “The signature on the form is _____”?
swaps.explanation: Illegible is il- + legible: the l doubles where the prefix meets legible, and legible ends in -ible.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling is correct in the phrase “The new form is _____ faster”?
swaps.explanation: Undoubtedly is un- + doubted + -ly. It keeps the silent b of doubt and the -ed.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling correctly completes “With only two clerks on duty, delays were _____”?
swaps.explanation: Inevitable is in- + evitable (avoidable), with a single n and the -able ending.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Which spelling is correct in the sentence “The clerk _____ deleted the wrong file”?
swaps.explanation: Accidentally is accidental + -ly, so it keeps -al- and ends in -lly. The double c of accident stays.
swaps.status: proposed (CoS verdict pending; no DB change)

swaps.stem: Choose the correctly spelled word for something that annoys or causes trouble.
swaps.explanation: Nuisance is spelled nui-sance: u before i, and the ending is -ance with a c.
